paths.note: Top-hole shortcut out of the first room: runs through the right hole are cut. Buy-machine room: a wall on the left side of CashPerLoop (the rightmost machine) cuts runs heading left past it; every route turns back right of it, and the search otherwise spends most of its runs out there. The pocket above and right of the climb, over Checkpoint (1)'s floor (from the floor's left edge to the wall right of the spiked block, up to the hanging pillar's spikes), is cut: every route climbs left of it.

paths.note: Left side: everything left of the rightmost buy machine's left edge (x 19644.9), top to bottom, is cut. Every route goes right from the start; the search otherwise spends most of its runs out west.

No orange blocks (the upgrade after double jump): runs that go far left, into the low left corner, or deep below the start floor are cut (the super jump off the bottom wall left of the floor dips about 110 below it, so that stays open); the way left under the maze to Checkpoint (1) stays open.

Forward only: runs that go back right past the course entry (into the shop room and the hub) are cut. The start room's ceiling hole is the finish (RealEnd, a trigger just under the ceiling), entered from above: a run climbing up through it never started the timer (the start gate is left, and End (1) cancels a timed run coming back right), so the hole's column below RealEnd is cut.
Roof: the route goes inside the building, so everything from the roof's underside (y 3081) up, from the far-left cut rightward, is cut, which closes the climb over the building's top left corner.
